import HexPrimality.Elab
import HexIntFactor.Primality

open Lean Hex.PrimalityTactic

-- Let the finite construction allocation finish independently of elaboration fuel.
set_option maxHeartbeats 0

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  unless constructionExtensionNames == [`HexIntFactor.PrimalityTactic.constructionExtension] do
    throwError "the current construction portfolio changed; update the comparator"
  let (result, allocations) ← construct 103486501344950896190452867069749997421755885175897313753651924906679932591353 Hex.Nat.constructionBudget
  unless allocations.any (fun (name, _) => name == ``Hex.Nat.ecmConstructionFactor) == false do
    throwError "ECM extension allocation changed"
  match result with
  | .ok _ => throwError "expected full construction exhaustion for 103486501344950896190452867069749997421755885175897313753651924906679932591353"
  | .error f =>
    unless f.stop == .exhausted && f.attempts == 1024 do
      throwError "construction outcome changed for 103486501344950896190452867069749997421755885175897313753651924906679932591353"
    logInfo "FULL_CONSTRUCTION validation-256-4: exhausted after {f.attempts} attempts"
  let (result, allocations) ← construct 115219968303613180170318760115437973610941062152781770424416328511434156923419 Hex.Nat.constructionBudget
  unless allocations.any (fun (name, _) => name == ``Hex.Nat.ecmConstructionFactor) == false do
    throwError "ECM extension allocation changed"
  match result with
  | .ok _ => throwError "expected full construction exhaustion for 115219968303613180170318760115437973610941062152781770424416328511434156923419"
  | .error f =>
    unless f.stop == .exhausted && f.attempts == 1024 do
      throwError "construction outcome changed for 115219968303613180170318760115437973610941062152781770424416328511434156923419"
    logInfo "FULL_CONSTRUCTION validation-256-5: exhausted after {f.attempts} attempts"
  let (result, allocations) ← construct 96590133568377947488922651108406533027621815589740576200326951544495709460191 Hex.Nat.constructionBudget
  unless allocations.any (fun (name, _) => name == ``Hex.Nat.ecmConstructionFactor) == false do
    throwError "ECM extension allocation changed"
  match result with
  | .ok _ => throwError "expected full construction exhaustion for 96590133568377947488922651108406533027621815589740576200326951544495709460191"
  | .error f =>
    unless f.stop == .exhausted && f.attempts == 1024 do
      throwError "construction outcome changed for 96590133568377947488922651108406533027621815589740576200326951544495709460191"
    logInfo "FULL_CONSTRUCTION validation-256-7: exhausted after {f.attempts} attempts"
